review: Read-only source trace. The statements identify ordering and possible synchronization boundaries; they are not additional native execution or proof of a cold-start cause.

files.observation: The parity title query may match its catalog card. The unchanged Modular test waits for sourceLink.exists, then unwraps a hittable native CollectionView/Table immediately.

Compatibility synchronous calls precede existing asynchronous alternatives; sequential JSC, Node, Python, fetch and self-request run during module evaluation. UI label changes are enqueued on NSOperationQueue.mainQueue.
Legacy JSC/Node/Python Task paths directly invoke completion; generic executeRuntime uses a separate MainActor path. Self-request invocation is MainActor-routed.

prepareHostRuntime synchronously hashes/prepares the embedded archive before NodeRuntimeBridge.start and before the Node ready wait. Source provides a possible cold-start stage, not a measured attribution of the entire observed delay.
start calls runMainApplication synchronously before returning.
The RUN_MAIN_OK marker occurs only after the original NativeScript runMainApplication call returns.
Background callback delivery uses CFRunLoopPerformBlock and WakeUp; synchronous wrappers pump the main run loop. The retained actual installed binary binds this current code.
The active NativeScript controller is assigned after session.start returns.

The actual Expo NativeResultDetail contains an unconditional native List and its Open in Sefaria Link. getText is only triggered later by the Full text action; opening a search result does not await this HTTP request.
